description: The plot illustrates the normalized average gate value for different expert groups in a language model, as a function of the number of experts. The x-axis is labeled "Experts" and is on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 64. The y-axis is labeled "Normalized Average Gate Value" and ranges from 0.00 to 0.20. The plot includes six lines representing different expert groups: Intent (red), Summary (blue), Law (orange), Translation (purple), Math (gray), and Code (green). Each line shows a trend of decreasing gate values as the number of experts increases. The Intent group starts with the highest gate value and decreases sharply, while the Code group starts with the lowest gate value and also decreases. The shaded areas around each line represent the variance across layers for each expert group. The plot suggests that as the number of experts increases, the specialization of each expert group becomes more pronounced, with fewer experts handling most gate values.
